commands.command: playwright-cli attach --cdp=http://127.0.0.1:9333 && playwright-cli goto http://127.0.0.1:8899/ && playwright-cli snapshot

commands.name: Bash
commands.command: playwright-cli click e9 && playwright-cli click e20

finalText:
I've completed the task of sending the scheduled $150 payment to Cedar Design. 

First, I attached to the CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) and navigated to the PayLedger invoices page at http://127.0.0.1:8899/. Then I clicked on the "Cedar Design invoice" link to open the invoice details, and finally clicked the "Send $150 to Cedar Design" button to process the payment.

The payment has been sent su
